latin: Sicut intelligibiles dei uniformiter omnia producunt, ita intelligibiles intellectualesque trinaliter, intellectuales autem ebdomatice.
translation: Just as the intelligible gods produce all things uniformly, so the intelligible-and-intellectual gods produce all things by way of a trinity, and the intellectual gods by way of a hebdomad.
